name: smwsprites-firework
title: Firework
description:
This is a disassembly of the firework sprite (7A), usually spawned after Bowser is defeated.
The four different types of fireworks (small, big, normal, heart) are included as 4 different .cfg files.
There are two options that can be turned on or off in the asm file, so read that for more information.
